visualText.title: Build powerful mapping solutions with ArcGIS for Developers
visualText.paragraph: ArcGIS for Developers offers a full suite of developer tools and resources to build mapping and analytics solutions that support your business needs. Use ArcGIS APIs to create robust, location-based web and native applications for web, desktop, and mobile devices. Build, manage, and deploy apps as quickly as possible by using the specific tools you need, when you need them—priced to fit your individual needs.

blocks.title: Map and visualize
blocks.desc: Create rich, interactive data visualizations in 2D or 3D while taking advantage of data-driven visualizations. ArcGIS offers best-in-class resolution and sophisticated symbology with these features:
bullets: 2D and 3D capabilities in the same API

blocks.title: Ready-to-use data
blocks.desc: Get access to the world's largest geospatial content library. Access thousands of ready-to-use basemaps and authoritative datasets provided by Esri, its partners and distributors, government agencies, our user community, and commercial content providers.

blocks.title: Search & geocoding
blocks.desc: Geocoding is the first and most important step in making sense of location information. Find addresses, place-names, cities, and businesses, and display their locations on a map with ArcGIS. Features include the following:
bullets: Geosearch, batch geocode, and reverse geocode
Searchable locations—search up to one million locations for free

blocks.title: Demographic and lifestyle data
blocks.desc: Enhance your authoritative content with detailed location intelligence. Get access to thousands of business and demographic variables for addresses, locations, and study areas in more than 130 countries. Enrich your data with industry-leading authoritative content. Generate PDF reports to display results and much more.

blocks.title: Spatial analysis
blocks.desc: Gain insights into your data by understanding spatial relationships and patterns. Perform the following functions in ArcGIS:
bullets: Identify patterns and make informed decisions
Utilize a vast set of analytic tools
Quickly and easily use the results in your apps

sections.title: Hosted data
sections.desc: Store your data securely in the cloud or behind your firewall. Manage, query, and edit data with ArcGIS tools and your own applications. With ArcGIS, you can do the following:
bullets: Import, create, and manage spatial and nonspatial data

sections.title: Work offline
sections.desc: Build native applications for use when your device goes offline and gain access to these features:
bullets: Search, geocode, and get routes and directions
